title: Existence of smooth-functorial saturated resolution of finite fine fans
statement: There exists a smooth-functorial saturated desingularization $\mathcal R$ of fine torsion-free fans with finite affine covers [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. Thus $\mathcal R(F)$ is a finite tower of saturated blowups along nonempty coherent monoid ideals with smooth last fan, and for a smooth morphism $g:G\to F$, $\mathcal R(G)$ is canonically the contraction of $g^*\mathcal R(F)$, retaining the centers and their order. The identifications respect composition and apply also to open localizations, isomorphisms, and inclusions into finite disjoint unions.

proof.text: Obtain a rational SchemeRule F and centered LiftRule T with smooth terminal monoschemes from [lem-trf-resolving-centered-toric-lift-rule]. Apply [lem-trf-monoscheme-tower-comparison-coherence] to obtain CoherentComparisons T. Restrict the inputs to the full subcategory with both ordinary and sharp stalk group completions torsion free, as required by [lem-trf-sharpening-fan-bijection]. For each input use T.lift verbatim as its resolution, retaining length, base and terminal smoothness. For each smooth map use the supplied pulled tower, pullback, base-map equation, contraction and base-isomorphism equation. The four identity/composition fields are precisely those of CoherentComparisons. This constructs a monoscheme SmoothFunctorialDesingularization with no new choice of tower or comparison.

Extract the equivalence from [lem-trf-sharpening-fan-bijection] and apply it to the assembled monoscheme rule. Its image is a smooth-functorial saturated fan desingularization, with all ordered centers, comparison laws and local fan descent already encoded by the equivalence and its RuleSharpens clauses. The special rank-zero smooth maps fall under this same structure by [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup].
